verdicts.reason: A keeps the jar on its circle and keeps the quote above the attribution, but the jar is shrunk so far that its SOLSTICE label can't be read, the quote is small, and a large empty gap sits between the quote mark and the quote. B moves the jar to the far left, away from the circle, so the circle becomes an empty blob on the right and the jar crowds the left edge.

A inverts the hierarchy: the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is set much bigger than the quote, the quote wraps to leave the orphan 'soon.', and the text runs right up against the circle and jar. B keeps the original hierarchy, but the jar is tiny with an unreadable label and there is dead space under the quote mark.

A breaks apart: the attribution floats alone at the far left, the oversized quote mark is cut off from the quote, and the quote is a tiny single line at the bottom, so it is barely readable and the reading order is jumbled. B is coherent, with the quote mark, then the quote, then the attribution, and the jar on its circle; its flaws are the tiny jar label and a loose gap above the quote.

A sets the attribution larger than the quote, ends the quote on the orphan 'soon.', and moves the jar away from its circle, so the circle sits empty on the right. B keeps the hierarchy and the jar-on-circle composition, though the jar is small with an illegible label and the spacing under the quote mark is loose.
